text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — OrbitAI (pilot) wants to onboard a private multilingual voice-to-text summarizer (13B) into Private. Requirements: HSM for keys, PHI redaction, <200ms token-latency target for short responses, and a canary/rollout plan. Can we scope evals and gate checks? @sam_se @julian_ml

sam_se: I can take this. Quick q's: what's the expected QPS and typical audio length? Are they sending raw WAVs or pre-transcribed text? Also any hard budget/throughput SLA from the customer?

maria_cs: They expect bursty traffic, ~15 qps peak, avg audio 8–20s. They'll send WAVs; we need to run transcription + summarization pipeline. Budget: they asked for predictable latency, willing to commit to Dedicated but prefer Private initially for PHI.

julian_ml: For the model stack: recommend transcription in a separate lighter model (whisper-ish) then 13B summarizer. For Private we should advise int8 quantization and KV cache tuning. For safety evals: we need a PHI-sensitive eval set + hallucination-weighted metrics. I'll draft eval seed with 300 labeled samples in EN/ES/FR.

noor_security: HSM/KMS notes — Private with customer-managed KMS is required. Confirm HSM for key wrapping only or full attested enclave? Also need data flow diagram and retention policy. We'll need customer SOC2 docs and a short threat model before approval.

sam_se: Good checklist. Can we do an initial perf/cost tradeoff: dedicated 2xA10G GPU pool vs single private host with batching? For <200ms token-latency on short replies we probably need lower batch sizes + prefix caching.

julian_ml: Agree. Suggest config prototype:```onboard_config:
  deployment: private
  model: custom-13b-summarizer
  quantization: int8
  frontend: wav->transcript
  transcriber: small-ctc-1
  cache: prefix_kv
  hsm: customer_kms
  canary: 5% traffic -> 20% -> 100%
  eval_sets: phi_multilang_v1
  metrics: rougeL, factuality_score, phi_leak_rate
```

maria_cs: Nice. Can we also add a rollback policy: auto-fallback to hosted-7b summarizer if latency or phi_leak_rate exceeds thresholds? Customer asked for graceful degradation.

julian_ml: Will add automatic fallback rule. Also recommend continuous eval: run 50 random production samples/day against eval probes. If regressions > 3% on factuality or any phi_leak, trigger rollback.

noor_security: I'll own the dataflow and compliance checklist. Next actions: customer to share sample audio + contract language for data residency. Also need KMS ARN and access path.

sam_se: I'll schedule an enablement session with OrbitAI for Wed 10am PT to walk through integration (ingest, webhook schema, sample rate). I'll also spin up a cheap preprod cluster and run a 1-day perf test after they share samples.

maria_cs: Great — capturing action items: 1) Customer: share sample WAVs + residency docs (OrbitAI) 2) Noor: compliance checklist + HSM spec 3) Julian: eval seed + canary + rollback rules 4) Sam: enablement session + preprod perf run.

maria_cs: tagging this as high renewal-risk if onboarding stalls — keep me posted. :white_check_mark:
